overview.description: The FT Vest Buffered Allocation Growth ETF (BUFG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in enhanced growth alternatives. The fund is an actively-managed fund-of-funds that allocates exposure to defined outcome buffer ETFs referencing the SPY. BUFG was launched on Oct 26, 2021 and is issued by First Trust.
